mapper.select:
select u.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,u.user_name account,u.phonenumber mobile,u.avatar,u.status, d.dept_name departmentName,group_concat(distinct r.role_key order by r.role_key) roleCodes from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' where u.del_flag='0' and (u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and u.status=#{status}
and exists(select 1 from sys_user_role xur join sys_role xr on xr.role_id=xur.role_id where xur.user_id=u.user_id and xr.status='0' and xr.del_flag='0'
and (xr.role_key='anchor' or xr.role_name='主播') and (xr.role_key='controller' or xr.role_name='场控') and (xr.role_key='manager' or xr.role_name='运营' or xr.role_name='运营主管') and xr.role_key=#{roleCode} )
group by u.user_id order by u.status,u.nick_name

select b.ding_dept_id dingDeptId,b.sys_dept_id sysDeptId,b.parent_ding_dept_id parentDingDeptId, d.parent_id parentId,d.ancestors,d.dept_name deptName,d.status from live_ding_dept_bind b join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.sys_dept_id where b.ding_dept_id=#{dingDeptId}
select dept_id sysDeptId,parent_id parentId,ancestors,dept_name deptName,status from sys_dept where parent_id=#{parentId} and dept_name=#{deptName} and del_flag='0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into live_ding_dept_bind(ding_dept_id,sys_dept_id,parent_ding_dept_id,dept_name,sync_batch,last_sync_time,create_time) values(#{dingDeptId},#{sysDeptId},#{parentDingDeptId},#{deptName},#{syncBatch},sysdate(),sysdate()) on duplicate key update sys_dept_id=values(sys_dept_id),parent_ding_dept_id=values(parent_ding_dept_id), dept_name=values(dept_name),sync_batch=values(sync_batch),last_sync_time=sysdate()
mapper.select: select user_id userId,user_name userName,status from sys_user where (user_name=#{userName} or phonenumber=#{userName}) and del_flag='0' order by (user_name=#{userName}) desc,user_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user(dept_id,user_name,nick_name,phonenumber,avatar,sex,password,status,del_flag,create_by,create_time,remark) values(#{deptId},#{userName},#{nickName},#{mobile},#{avatar},#{sex},#{password},#{status},'0',#{operator},sysdate(),'钉钉通讯录自动同步')

insert into live_ding_user_bind(ding_user_id,user_id,sync_batch,last_sync_time,create_time) values(#{dingUserId},#{userId},#{syncBatch},sysdate(),sysdate()) on duplicate key update user_id=values(user_id),sync_batch=values(sync_batch),last_sync_time=sysdate()
mapper.update: update sys_user u set u.status='1',u.update_by=#{username},u.update_time=sysdate() where u.user_id<>1 and exists(select 1 from live_ding_user_bind old_bind where old_bind.user_id=u.user_id) and not exists(select 1 from live_ding_user_bind current_bind where current_bind.user_id=u.user_id and current_bind.sync_batch=#{syncBatch})
mapper.select: select shop_id shopId,shop_code shopCode,shop_name shopName,platform_name platformName,status from erp_shop where status='0' order by shop_name
select shop_id shopId,shop_code shopCode,shop_name shopName,platform_code platformCode, platform_name platformName,owner_name ownerName,status,remark from erp_shop where shop_id=#{shopId}

select r.room_id roomId,r.room_code roomCode,r.room_name roomName, r.platform_room_id platformRoomId,r.live_account liveAccount,r.owner_staff_id ownerStaffId, u.nick_name ownerName,r.status,r.remark from live_room r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.owner_staff_id and r.room_name like concat('%',#{roomName},'%') and r.status=#{status} order by r.status,r.room_id desc
select room_id roomId,room_code roomCode,room_name roomName,platform_room_id platformRoomId,live_account liveAccount,owner_staff_id ownerStaffId,status,remark from live_room where room_id=#{roomId}

select x.subjectType,x.subjectId,x.subjectCode,x.subjectName,x.status, (select group_concat(m.user_id order by u.nick_name) from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.subject_type=x.subjectType and m.subject_id=x.subjectId and m.role_code='anchor') anchorIds, (select group_concat(u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.subject_type=x.subjectType and m.subject_id=x.subjectId and m.role_code='anchor') anchorNames, (select group_concat(m.user_id order by u.nick_name) from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.subject_type=x.subjectType and m.subject_id=x.subjectId and m.role_code='controller') controllerIds, (select group_concat(u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') from live_subject_user_map m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.subject_type=x.subjectType and m.subject_id=x.subjectId and m.role_code='controller') controllerNames from ( select 'ROOM' subjectType,room_id subjectId,room_code subjectCode,room_name subjectName,status from live_room union all select 'SHOP' subjectType,shop_id subjectId,shop_code subjectCode,shop_name subjectName,status from erp_shop ) x
and x.subjectType=#{subjectType} and (x.subjectCode like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or x.subjectName like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by x.subjectType,x.status,x.subjectName
mapper.delete: delete from live_subject_user_map where subject_type=#{subjectType} and subject_id=#{subjectId}
mapper.select: select d.daily_id dailyId,d.live_date liveDate,d.shop_id shopId,s.shop_name shopName,d.room_id roomId,r.room_name roomName,d.remark, (select group_concat(u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') from live_daily_user ds join sys_user u on u.user_id=ds.user_id where ds.daily_id=d.daily_id and ds.role_code='anchor') anchors, (select group_concat(u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') from live_daily_user ds join sys_user u on u.user_id=ds.user_id where ds.daily_id=d.daily_id and ds.role_code='controller') controllers, (select count(*) from erp_order_gift_status ogs where ogs.daily_id=d.daily_id) handledOrders, (select ifnull(sum(og.total_cost),0) from erp_order_gift_status ogs join erp_order_gift og on og.order_no=ogs.order_no and og.cost_status='included' where ogs.daily_id=d.daily_id) giftCost from live_daily_record d join erp_shop s on s.shop_id=d.shop_id join live_room r on r.room_id=d.room_id and d.live_date>=#{beginDate}and d.live_date<=#{endDate}and d.shop_id=#{shopId}and d.room_id=#{roomId} order by d.live_date desc,d.daily_id desc

select d.daily_id dailyId,d.live_date liveDate,d.shop_id shopId,d.room_id roomId,d.remark,(select group_concat(user_id) from live_daily_user where daily_id=d.daily_id and role_code='anchor') anchorIds,(select group_concat(user_id) from live_daily_user where daily_id=d.daily_id and role_code='controller') controllerIds from live_daily_record d where d.daily_id=#{dailyId}

select g.gift_id giftId,g.gift_code giftCode,g.gift_name giftName,g.short_name shortName,g.brand,g.model,g.specification,g.unit,g.category,g.image_url imageUrl,g.purchase_type purchaseType,g.status,g.sort_order sortOrder,g.remark, coalesce(p.hidden,0) personalHidden,coalesce(p.pinned,0) personalPinned,coalesce(p.sort_order,0) personalSortOrder, coalesce((select i.stock_qty from live_gift_inventory i where i.gift_id=g.gift_id),0) stockQty, (select c.unit_cost from erp_gift_cost c where c.gift_id=g.gift_id and c.effective_date<=#{costDate}current_date order by c.effective_date desc,c.cost_id desc limit 1) currentCost, (select c.effective_date from erp_gift_cost c where c.gift_id=g.gift_id and c.effective_date<=#{costDate}current_date order by c.effective_date desc,c.cost_id desc limit 1) costEffectiveDate, (select group_concat(a.alias_name separator '、') from erp_gift_alias a where a.gift_id=g.gift_id) aliases from erp_gift g left join live_user_gift_preference p on p.gift_id=g.gift_id and p.user_id=#{userId} and (g.gift_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or g.gift_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or g.short_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or exists(select 1 from erp_gift_alias a where a.gift_id=g.gift_id and a.alias_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')))and g.status=#{status}and coalesce(p.hidden,0)=0 order by coalesce(p.pinned,0) desc,coalesce(p.sort_order,0),g.status,g.sort_order,g.gift_id desc

select gift_id giftId,gift_code giftCode,gift_name giftName,short_name shortName,brand,model,specification,unit,category,image_url imageUrl,purchase_type purchaseType,status,sort_order sortOrder,remark,(select group_concat(alias_name separator ',') from erp_gift_alias where gift_id=g.gift_id) aliases from erp_gift g where gift_id=#{giftId}
select gift_id giftId,gift_code giftCode,gift_name giftName,status from erp_gift where gift_code=#{giftCode}
mapper.insert: insert into erp_gift_version(gift_id,action_type,gift_code,gift_name,short_name,brand,model,specification,unit,category,purchase_type,status,sort_order,aliases_snapshot,remark,create_by,create_time) select g.gift_id,#{actionType},g.gift_code,g.gift_name,g.short_name,g.brand,g.model,g.specification,g.unit,g.category,g.purchase_type,g.status,g.sort_order, (select group_concat(a.alias_name order by a.alias_name separator '、') from erp_gift_alias a where a.gift_id=g.gift_id),g.remark,#{username},sysdate() from erp_gift g where g.gift_id=#{giftId}
mapper.select: select version_id versionId,action_type actionType,gift_code giftCode,gift_name giftName,short_name shortName, specification,unit,status,sort_order sortOrder,aliases_snapshot aliases,remark,create_by createBy,create_time createTime from erp_gift_version where gift_id=#{giftId} order by version_id desc

select cost_id costId,gift_id giftId,unit_cost unitCost,effective_date effectiveDate,change_reason changeReason,create_by createBy,create_time createTime from erp_gift_cost where gift_id=#{giftId} order by effective_date desc,cost_id desc
select cost_id costId from erp_gift_cost where gift_id=#{giftId} and effective_date=#{effectiveDate} limit 1
select cost_id costId,unit_cost unitCost,effective_date effectiveDate from erp_gift_cost where gift_id=#{giftId} and effective_date<=#{costDate} order by effective_date desc,cost_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into live_user_gift_preference(user_id,gift_id,hidden,pinned,sort_order,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{giftId},#{hidden},#{pinned},#{sortOrder},#{username},sysdate()) on duplicate key update hidden=values(hidden),pinned=values(pinned),sort_order=values(sort_order),update_by=values(update_by),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.select: select template_id templateId,template_name templateName,content_json contentJson,status,sort_order sortOrder, create_time createTime,update_time updateTime from live_quick_template where template_id=#{templateId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: update live_quick_template set template_name=#{templateName},content_json=cast(#{contentJson} as json),status=#{status}, sort_order=#{sortOrder},update_by=#{username},update_time=sysdate() where template_id=#{templateId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from live_quick_template where template_id=#{templateId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select o.sales_id salesId,o.main_order_no orderNo,o.shop_id shopId,o.shop_name shopName,o.pay_amount payAmount,o.pay_time payTime,date(o.pay_time) orderDate,o.order_status orderStatus,group_concat(i.product_name order by i.item_id separator '；') productName,sum(i.quantity) quantity from erp_sales_order o left join erp_sales_order_item i on i.sales_id=o.sales_id where o.main_order_no=#{orderNo} group by o.sales_id limit 1

select order_no orderNo,process_status processStatus,daily_id dailyId,room_id roomId,room_code_snapshot roomCodeSnapshot,room_name_snapshot roomNameSnapshot,operator_note operatorNote,anchor_user_id anchorUserId,anchor_name_snapshot anchorNameSnapshot,controller_user_id controllerUserId,controller_name_snapshot controllerNameSnapshot,refund_amount refundAmount,refund_reason refundReason,other_remark otherRemark,after_sale_compensation afterSaleCompensation,service_mark serviceMark,extended_warranty extendedWarranty,price_protection priceProtection,`delayed` `delayed`,follow_up followUp,urgent,template_id templateId,template_name_snapshot templateNameSnapshot,parsed_text parsedText,create_by createBy,create_time createTime,update_by updateBy,update_time updateTime from erp_order_gift_status where order_no=#{orderNo}

select order_gift_id orderGiftId,order_no orderNo,gift_id giftId,quantity,gift_name_snapshot giftName,specification_snapshot specification,unit_snapshot unit,unit_cost_snapshot unitCost,total_cost totalCost,price_effective_date priceEffectiveDate,cost_status costStatus from erp_order_gift where order_no=#{orderNo} order by order_gift_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_order_gift_status(order_no,process_status,daily_id,room_id,room_code_snapshot,room_name_snapshot,operator_note,anchor_user_id,anchor_name_snapshot,controller_user_id,controller_name_snapshot,refund_amount,refund_reason,other_remark,after_sale_compensation,service_mark,extended_warranty,price_protection,`delayed`,follow_up,urgent,template_id,template_name_snapshot,parsed_text,create_by,create_time) values(#{orderNo},#{processStatus},#{dailyId},#{roomId},#{roomCodeSnapshot},#{roomNameSnapshot},#{operatorNote},#{anchorUserId},#{anchorNameSnapshot},#{controllerUserId},#{controllerNameSnapshot},#{refundAmount},#{refundReason},#{otherRemark},#{afterSaleCompensation},#{serviceMark},#{extendedWarranty},#{priceProtection},#{delayed},#{followUp},#{urgent},#{templateId},#{templateNameSnapshot},#{parsedText},#{username},sysdate()) on duplicate key update process_status=values(process_status),daily_id=values(daily_id),room_id=values(room_id),room_code_snapshot=values(room_code_snapshot),room_name_snapshot=values(room_name_snapshot),operator_note=values(operator_note),anchor_user_id=values(anchor_user_id),anchor_name_snapshot=values(anchor_name_snapshot),controller_user_id=values(controller_user_id),controller_name_snapshot=values(controller_name_snapshot),refund_amount=values(refund_amount),refund_reason=values(refund_reason),other_remark=values(other_remark),after_sale_compensation=values(after_sale_compensation),service_mark=values(service_mark),extended_warranty=values(extended_warranty),price_protection=values(price_protection),`delayed`=values(`delayed`),follow_up=values(follow_up),urgent=values(urgent),template_id=values(template_id),template_name_snapshot=values(template_name_snapshot),parsed_text=values(parsed_text),update_by=#{username},update_time=sysdate()
mapper.select: select p.room_id roomId,r.room_code roomCode,r.room_name roomName from live_user_room_preference p left join live_room r on r.room_id=p.room_id and r.status='0' where p.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into live_user_room_preference(user_id,room_id,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},#{roomId},#{username},sysdate()) on duplicate key update room_id=values(room_id),update_by=values(update_by),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.select:
select g.gift_id giftId,g.gift_code giftCode,g.gift_name giftName,g.unit,g.status, coalesce(i.stock_qty,0) stockQty,coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) safetyQty, case when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)=0 then 'zero' when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)<=coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) then 'low' else 'normal' end stockStatus, coalesce((select sum(a.quantity) from live_gift_order_inventory a where a.gift_id=g.gift_id),0) usedQty, (select max(m.create_time) from live_gift_inventory_movement m where m.gift_id=g.gift_id) lastMovementTime from erp_gift g left join live_gift_inventory i on i.gift_id=g.gift_id
and (g.gift_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or g.gift_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or g.short_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and g.status=#{status} and coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)=0 and coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)>0 and coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)<=coalesce(i.safety_qty,0)
order by case when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)=0 then 0 when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)<=coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) then 1 else 2 end,g.sort_order,g.gift_id desc

select m.movement_id movementId,m.gift_id giftId,g.gift_code giftCode,g.gift_name giftName, m.movement_type movementType,m.quantity,m.before_qty beforeQty,m.after_qty afterQty, m.source_type sourceType,m.source_no sourceNo,m.remark,m.create_by createBy,m.create_time createTime from live_gift_inventory_movement m join erp_gift g on g.gift_id=m.gift_id and m.gift_id=#{giftId}and date(m.create_time)>=#{beginDate}and date(m.create_time)<=#{endDate} order by m.movement_id desc
select gift_id giftId,stock_qty stockQty,safety_qty safetyQty from live_gift_inventory where gift_id=#{giftId} for update
select order_no orderNo,gift_id giftId,quantity from live_gift_order_inventory where order_no=#{orderNo} for update

select count(*) giftCount,coalesce(sum(coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)),0) totalStock,coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)=0 then 1 else 0 end),0) zeroCount,coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)>0 and coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)<=coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) then 1 else 0 end),0) lowCount from erp_gift g left join live_gift_inventory i on i.gift_id=g.gift_id where g.status='0'

select g.gift_id giftId,g.gift_code giftCode,g.gift_name giftName,coalesce(i.stock_qty,0) stockQty,coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) safetyQty from erp_gift g left join live_gift_inventory i on i.gift_id=g.gift_id where g.status='0' and coalesce(i.stock_qty,0)<=coalesce(i.safety_qty,0) order by stockQty asc,g.gift_id desc limit 20

select s.order_no orderNo,date(max(s.create_time)) entryDate,max(s.create_time) createTime,max(s.process_status) processStatus,max(s.anchor_name_snapshot) anchorName,max(s.controller_name_snapshot) controllerName,max(s.refund_amount) refundAmount,max(s.refund_reason) refundReason,max(s.other_remark) otherRemark,max(s.after_sale_compensation) afterSaleCompensation,max(s.service_mark) serviceMark,max(s.extended_warranty) extendedWarranty,max(s.price_protection) priceProtection,max(s.`delayed`) `delayed`,max(s.follow_up) followUp,max(s.urgent) urgent,max(s.operator_note) operatorNote,max(s.create_by) createBy,max(coalesce(s.update_by,s.create_by)) operateBy,max(coalesce(s.update_time,s.create_time)) operateTime,group_concat(concat(g.gift_name_snapshot,'×',g.quantity) order by g.order_gift_id separator '、') giftText,group_concat(concat(g.gift_name_snapshot,'：',coalesce(i.stock_qty,0),'件') order by g.order_gift_id separator '、') stockText,ifnull(sum(if(g.cost_status='included',g.total_cost,0)),0) giftCost,ifnull(sum(g.quantity),0) giftQuantity from erp_order_gift_status s left join erp_order_gift g on g.order_no=s.order_no left join live_gift_inventory i on i.gift_id=g.gift_id and s.order_no like concat('%',#{orderNo},'%')and date(coalesce(s.update_time,s.create_time))>=#{beginDate}and date(coalesce(s.update_time,s.create_time))<=#{endDate}and exists(select 1 from erp_order_gift fg where fg.order_no=s.order_no and fg.gift_name_snapshot=#{giftName})and s.process_status=#{processStatus} group by s.order_no order by operateTime desc

select count(*) handledOrders,sum(if(x.process_status='selected',1,0)) giftOrders,ifnull(sum(x.gift_quantity),0) giftQuantity,ifnull(sum(x.gift_cost),0) giftCost,ifnull(sum(x.pay_amount),0) orderAmount from (select s.order_no,s.process_status,max(o.pay_amount) pay_amount,ifnull(sum(g.quantity),0) gift_quantity,ifnull(sum(if(g.cost_status='included',g.total_cost,0)),0) gift_cost from erp_order_gift_status s left join erp_sales_order o on o.main_order_no=s.order_no left join erp_order_gift g on g.order_no=s.order_no and date(coalesce(o.pay_time,s.update_time,s.create_time))>=#{beginDate}and date(coalesce(o.pay_time,s.update_time,s.create_time))<=#{endDate}and coalesce(o.shop_name,'未同步')=#{shopName} group by s.order_no,s.process_status) x

select g.gift_name_snapshotdate(coalesce(o.pay_time,s.update_time,s.create_time))coalesce(o.shop_name,'未同步') groupName,count(distinct s.order_no) orderCount,ifnull(sum(g.quantity),0) giftQuantity,ifnull(sum(if(g.cost_status='included',g.total_cost,0)),0) giftCost from erp_order_gift_status s left join erp_sales_order o on o.main_order_no=s.order_no left join erp_order_gift g on g.order_no=s.order_no and date(coalesce(o.pay_time,s.update_time,s.create_time))>=#{beginDate}and date(coalesce(o.pay_time,s.update_time,s.create_time))<=#{endDate}and coalesce(o.shop_name,'未同步')=#{shopName} group by groupName order by giftCost desc
